## Notes on Dependabot version updates

**Github Actions Policy**: only merge PRs generated by Dependabot if they are 7+ days old.

There are some open issues with the `cooldown` feature for Github Actions. Consequently, the Dependabot configuration (`dependabot.yml`) lets Dependabot check for updates on Github Actions every month. We implement a manual "cooldown" by delaying merging of Dependabot PRs by 7 days.

For `pip` packages, we use the cooldown feature, set to 7 days.
